messages:
ava: Heads-up  we need a tiny migration note + deprecation banner for SDK call rename (submit -> invoke). Target soft-announcement next Wed.
ryan: I can draft the PR body. Please paste minimal examples.
megan: I'll write the migration doc: short example, param rename list, and a 3-step smoke test.
tim: Ill handle the redirect + banner component. Suggest 301 from /sdk/submit -> /sdk/invoke and banner for 30 days.
ava: Timeline: soft announce Wed, 14-day auto-alias routing, 30-day banner, 90-day sunset. Mention auto-alias window clearly.
ryan: Snippet (JS): ```js
// old
await client.submit({ model: 'text-lite', input: 'hi' })
// new
await client.invoke({ model: 'text-pro', input: 'hi' })
```
megan: Note param rename: num_tokens -> max_tokens. Also embed dims change for embeds-v2. Add tiny python smoke test.
ops-bot: NOTE: auto-alias routing: enabled for 14 days after announcement. Audit logs will record fallback events.
ryan: Draft PR will include summary, timeline, snippets, and checklist. Posting link here when ready.
tim: Redirect PR will include banner text: "submit is deprecated  migrate to invoke. See migration guide."
megan: Migration checklist for guide: 1) replace submit -> invoke; 2) rename params; 3) run embedding dim check; 4) run token-count smoke.
ava: Action items: Ryan  PR draft; Megan  doc + tests; Tim  redirect/banner; Ava  announcement copy. Ping me if blocked.
